title: Finland – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – SATKAT-järjestelmä
description: Puolustusvoimien logistiikkalaitos (jäljempänä Hankintayksikkö) pyytää osallistumishakemustanne SATKAT-järjestelmän hankintaan Puolustusvoimille tämän osallistumishakemuspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnan kohteena on avaruustilannekuvan SATKAT-tietojärjestelmä. SATKAT-järjestelmään poimitaan tietoja ja siirretään implementoitavan yhdyskäytävän läpi SATKAT-järjestelmän satelliittikatalogiin. Keskeisimmät järjestelmän käyttötapaukset on kuvattu liitteessä 4. Se sisältää tarjouspyynnössä vaadittavan, tarjouspyyntövaiheessa tarjoajan toteuttaman käyttötapausten demonstroinnin ja metodologian sekä pisteytyksen kuvauksen. Dokumentti saatetaan tiedoksi osallistumishakemusvaiheessa tarkoituksena tarjota yrityksille tietoa tulevan tarjouspyynnön keskeisestä sisällöstä eikä liitteessä 4 vaadittuja dokumentteja tarvitse toimittaa osallistumishakemuksen liitteenä. Se mahdollistaa yritysten valmistautumisen teknisesti vaativan järjestelmän tarjoamiseen antamalla tietoa resurssien, potentiaalisten kumppanuus- ja tuotetarpeiden sekä innovatiivisten ratkaisujen alustavaan analysointiin. Hankinnan kohteen tekninen määrittely ja tuoterakenne esitetään tarjouspyynnössä. Hankinnan kohteena on SATKAT-järjestelmä, jonka toimitus koostuu seuraavista kokonaisuuksista 1. Satelliittikatalogin tuottaminen 2. Järjestelmän ohjelmistojen tuottaminen a. Satelliittikatalogin ylläpidon ja käytön ohjelmistot b. Tilannekuvatuotteiden generoinnin ohjelmistot c. Astrodynamiikan laskentamoottori tilannekuvatuotteiden generointia varten d. Astrodynamiikan analyysiohjelmisto e. Astrodynamiikan katseluohjelmisto f. Ohjelmointirajapinnan (API) tuottaminen (tietojen vienti katalogiin) 3. Yhdyskäytävään liittyvä määrittely- ja toteutustyö tarjouspyynnössä kuvattavalla tavalla. 4. Ohjelmistotuotteiden käyttöoikeus 5. Järjestelmän testaus- ja koulutustuki 6. Järjestelmän dokumentaation tuottaminen 7. Järjestelmän koulutus 6. Järjestelmän tuki- ja huolto Toimitus tulee sisältämään teknisen järjestelmän, sen asennuksen, integraation, testauksen ja hyväksynnän, dokumentoinnin ja koulutuksen sekä tuen ja osallistumisen järjestelmän asennuksiin laboratorio-, tuotantotestaus- ja operatiiviseen ympäristöön. Toimittaja tuottaa Hankintasopimuksen mukaiset palvelut ensisijaisesti suomen kielellä. Mikäli työ edellyttää työskentelyä puolustusvoimien tiloissa, Ehdokas sitoutuu tuottamaan palvelut puolustusvoimien osoittamissa tiloissa Suomessa. Varsinaisten työskentelytilojen lisäksi ehdokas suostuu tuottamaan palveluita myös muissa puolustusvoimien tiloissa Suomessa, mikäli Puolustusvoimat sitä edellyttää. Toimittajan tulee tuottaa järjestelmän kehittämis-, integrointi-, ylläpito-, vika- ja häiriökorjauskyvykkyys Suomeen järjestelmän sotilaallisen huoltovarmuuden turvaamiseksi. Toimittajan tulee kyetä tuottamaan näitä palveluita Suomessa kaikissa häiriötilanteissa, myös poikkeusoloissa, kuten sota. SATKAT-tietojärjestelmä rakennetaan on-premise Air gap ympäristöön. On-premise Air gap ympäristöön ei ole mahdollista sallia rajoitettua yhteyttä Internetissä sijaitseviin luotettuihin lähteisiin. Hankintaan sisältyy myös järjestelmän tuki- ja huoltosopimus. Tuki- ja huoltosopimus tulee sisältämään järjestelmän käytön aikaista käyttäjätukea, säännölliset järjestelmän päivitykset, ohjelmistojen ylläpitopalvelut ml. ohjelmistojen ylläpidollinen kehittäminen/modifiointi, asennus- ja konfigurointipalvelut asiakkaan ympäristöissä sekä mahdollisesti erikseen tarjouspyynnössä/sopimuksessa määriteltyjen laitteiden vikakorjaus- ja vaihtolaitepalvelun.

title: Subcontracting Framework for Works and Associated Services
description: Tayside Contracts invites suitably qualified and experienced contractors to submit a completed Single Procurement Document (SPD) in connection with the proposed Subcontracting Framework for Works and Associated Services. The Framework is intended to provide a flexible, compliant and efficient route to market for subcontracted works and specialist services that supplement internal delivery capacity and support operational resilience across the organisation. This procurement will be conducted using the Restricted Procedure in accordance with the Public Contracts (Scotland) Regulations 2015. The procurement will be undertaken in two stages: - Stage 1 - Selection Stage (SPD): Applicants must complete the Single Procurement Document (SPD) and meet the minimum selection criteria. Responses will be evaluated to shortlist Applicants to proceed to the ITT stage. The Invitation to tender documents will not be issued at this stage. -Stage 2 - Invitation to Tender (ITT): Shortlisted Applicants will be invited to submit detailed technical and commercial tenders, including pricing, methodology and quality proposals, for evaluation and Framework appointment.

title: VE 906 Leitstellen IT-Infrastruktur
description: Die Integrierte Leitstelle Rems-Murr (ILS) und die Integrierte Regionalleitstelle Ostwürttemberg (IRLS) werden die beiden Leitstellen zukünftig als Partnerleitstellen so betreiben, dass die Leitstellen im Regelbetrieb eng zusammenarbeiten und sich gegenseitig unterstützen. Im Falle eines Ausfalls eines Standortes sollen beide Leitstellen von einem Standort aus betrieben werden. Dazu wird entsprechende Leitstellen-IT-Infrastruktur beschafft, so dass die Leitstellen zukünftig in einem Verbund arbeiten. Die Leistung umfasst dabei für beide Standorte • das IT-Virtualisierungssystem zum Betrieb der Leitstellen-Einsatzleitsoftware COBRA des Herstellers ISE zur Notrufbearbeitung, Telekommunikation und Funk-Vermittlung und dessen Schnittstellen. • IT-Sicherheitsinfrastruktur • die dazu notwendige Netzwerkinfrastruktur, bestehend aus Netzwerken und Netzwerkmanagement, inkl. Monitoring • Integration von Verschlüsselungskomponenten • Gebäudetechnikintegration • Schnittstellen zu verschiedenen externen Systemen (RTT, AML, BMA, DA, KMS, etc.) • und die zugehörigen Projektdienstleistungen. Der Leistungsumfang des Auftragnehmers (AN) umfasst die Bereitstellung der für die jeweiligen Systeme erforderlichen Software- und Hardwarekomponenten sowie die Sicherstellung der vollständigen Funktionsfähigkeit der Schnittstellen untereinander. Der AN erbringt neben dem Aufbau der Systeme explizit auch die Leistung eines Systemintegrators. Seine Aufgabe ist die Integration des eigenen Systems und der für dieses Projekt beigestellten, über Schnittstellen verbundenen Systeme und weiterer Einrichtungen des AG. Hauptmassen: Virtualisierungsserver / Firewalls / Netzwerkkomponenten /Arbeitsplatzrechner

title: Netherlands – Refuse disposal and treatment – Europese aanbesteding Afvalinzameling t.b.v. Stichting Openbaar Onderwijs Groningen
description: Het doel van deze aanbesteding is: - het afsluiten van een (raam)overeenkomst met één Opdrachtnemer voor een periode van vier jaar, met een optie tot verlenging voor een periode van maximaal twee maal één jaar. De keuze tot het al dan niet verlengen van de (raam)overeenkomst berust uitsluitend bij Opdrachtgever. De beoogde datum van ingang van de (raam)overeenkomst is 1 maart 2027 en eindigt van rechtswege op 1 maart 2031 tenzij de Opdrachtgever kiest voor optionele verlenging(en). Maximale looptijd van de (raam)overeenkomst, indien wordt gekozen voor optionele verlengingen, bedraagt zes jaar, tot uiterlijk 1 maart 2033. De beoogde datum van ingang kan, indien Opdrachtgever dit noodzakelijk acht, aangepast worden naar een latere datum, waarbij de einddatum navenant wordt aangepast. De netto opdrachtwaarde voor afvalinzameling was in 2025, circa: € 114.000,00 exclusief BTW per jaar. Aan de voorgaande indicatie kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. De indicatie dient louter om potentiële inschrijvers een globaal beeld te geven van de omvang van de opdracht.

description: The aim of the procurement is to establish a framework agreement that ensures the Norwegian Parliament access to safes, fire cupboards and security cabinets with the accompanying services, including delivery and service and maintenance of both existing and newly procured cupboards. The procurement shall cover the Norwegian Parliament ́s ongoing need for secure storage of documents, values and equipment. The framework agreement shall assist the Norwegian Parliament in getting access to products with documented fire and burglary protection, as well as ensuring efficient and predictable ordering, delivery and service processes. The contract shall also facilitate standardisation of products and lock solutions, good use of resources and competitive terms throughout the entire contract period. The procurement supports the Norwegian Parliament ́s need for safe and stable operation by ensuring that the company always has access to appropriate storage systems and the necessary professional assistance connected to maintenance and repairs. See the tender documentation for further information.

All SA Holders have been invited to submit a proposal. Description of the Requirement: The objective of this engagement is to enable the organization to successfully adopt and sustain the changes introduced by DFO digital investments as well as the overall transformation agenda for the department. The Change Management resources will focus on the people's side of change, ensuring employees understand, accept, and embrace new technologies, processes, and ways of working. This includes minimizing resistance, building stakeholder commitment, and fostering a culture that supports continuous improvement and innovation. In addition, the Change Management resources must establish, document, and continuously improve change management standards, frameworks, methodologies, tools, and governance practices to promote a consistent and scalable approach across all digital initiatives. They will be responsible for ensuring the consistent application of these standards across projects, programs, and business areas, enabling a cohesive and enterprise-wide approach to change adoption and transformation. The Change Management resources will also be expected to build internal organizational capability by training, coaching, mentoring, and supporting employees, leaders, project teams, and emerging change management practitioners. This includes transferring knowledge, developing practical change management competencies, and helping establish a sustainable community of practice that strengthens the department's long-term ability to lead and manage change independently. title: Järvenpään Mestariasunnot Oy: Wärtsilänkatu 18, pihaurakka
description: Järvenpään Mestariasunnot Oy: Wärtsilänkatu 18, pihaurakka Järvenpään Mestariasunnot Oy (jäljempänä ”Tilaaja”) pyytää tarjoustanne Wärtsilänkatu 18 (04410 Järvenpää) pihaurakasta tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Kohde on kerrostalokiinteistö (kiinteistötunnus 186-008-0801-0006), jonka pinta-ala on 5 378 m². Urakka käsittää kiinteistön piha-alueiden muutos- ja kunnostustyöt suunnitelmien mukaisessa laajuudessa. Tarjoajan tulee tutustua tarjottavaan kohteeseen ja siellä vallitseviin olosuhteisiin ennen tarjouksen antamista. Rakennuspaikka luovutetaan urakoitsijalle siinä kunnossa kuin se tarjoushetkellä on. Rakennuspaikkaan tulee tutustua omatoimisesti asukkaita häiritsemättä. Urakkasisältö kuvataan tarkemmin tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Alla yhteenveto urakkasisällöstä: - Piha-alueiden muutos- ja kunnostustyöt. - Vanhojen hyödynnettävien leikkivälineiden, kalusteiden ja aitojen kunnostus sekä mahdollinen siirto. - Uusien leikkivälineiden, kalusteiden ja pihavalaisimien hankinta ja asennus. - Jätehuollon upposäiliöjärjestelmän hankinta ja asennus. - Aitojen, porttien, tukimuurien ja muiden piharakenteiden rakentaminen. - Piha-alueiden pintarakenteiden, päällysteiden ja istutusten toteuttaminen. - Sadevesilinjojen, kivipesien ja muiden suunnitelmissa esitettyjen hulevesirakenteiden rakentaminen. - Suunnitelmien mukaiset kallion louhintatyöt. - Piha-alueiden massanvaihto- ja maansiirtotyöt. - Pihavalaistuksen, sähkösyöttöjen ja muiden sähkösuunnitelmien mukaisten asennusten toteuttaminen. - Sähköautojen latauspisteiden varausputkitukset sekä niihin liittyvät suunnitelmien mukaiset sähkö- ja rakennustyöt. - Kaikki muut suunnitelmien mukaiset hankinnat, työt ja asennukset täysin valmiiksi toteutettuina. Urakassa tulee huomioida, että kiinteistö on asuttu koko urakan ajan. Urakoitsijan tulee varmistaa asukkaiden turvallinen kulku rakennuksiin sekä kiinteistön välttämättömien toimintojen, huoltoliikenteen ja pelastusteiden käytettävyys koko rakennustyön ajan. Hanke toteutetaan kiinteähintaisena kokonaisurakkana. Valittu urakoitsija toimii hankkeen pääurakoitsijana ja päätoteuttajana vastaten työmaan johtovelvollisuuksista, työmaapalveluista sekä kaikkien sopimusasiakirjojen mukaisten töiden toteuttamisesta. Urakka-aika on 3.5.–30.7.2027. Urakan tulee olla kokonaisuudessaan valmis ja tilaajan hyväksytysti vastaanottama viimeistään 30.7.2027. Urakoitsijan tulee huomioida aikataulussaan vastaanottotarkastuksen edellyttämät valmistelut, itselleluovutus ja ennakkotarkastukset. Urakkasopimukseen liitetään ennen sen allekirjoittamista tilaajan hyväksymä, urakoitsijaa sitova sopimusaikataulu. Tarjoajan edellytetään tulkitsevan tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoja rakennusalan ammattilaisena ja asiantuntijana. Mikäli tarjoaja havaitsee tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa puutteita tai epäselvyyksiä, jotka voivat vaikuttaa tarjouksen sisältöön, niistä on tiedusteltava etukäteen. Hankintaan liittyvät kysymykset tulee esittää yksinomaan Tarjouspalvelu.fi-toimittajaportaalissa kohdassa ”Kysymykset ja vastaukset”. Urakan tarkempi sisältö, laatuvaatimukset, sopimusehdot sekä laskennallisiin määriin ja yksikköhintoihin liittyvät menettelyt määräytyvät tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Työn rahoituksesta vastaa Järvenpään Mestariasunnot Oy ja rakennuttamistehtävistä Mestaritoiminta Oy. title: Construction Services for Confined Aquatic Disposal Cell Construction and Maintenance Dredging of the Providence River Federal Navigation Project, Providence, Rhode Island.
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is issuing a Sources Sought Announcement for the upcoming dredging project located in Providence, Rhode Island. This announcement is to determine the interest, availability and capability of Small and Large Business concerns as described below. The NAICS code for this procurement is 237990. The solicitation for this project is anticipated to be issued on or about 15 March 2027. The construction will begin in September 2027 and is expected to take approximately 2 years to complete. The estimated construction cost is between $80,000,000 and $100,000,000. The Providence River Maintenance Dredging project involves two major sequences of dredging and disposal activities. The first work sequence will be the construction of a new Confined Aquatic Disposal (CAD) cell adjacent to the Providence River. The second work sequence under this contract will include maintenance dredging of the Providence River and Harbor Federal Navigation Project (FNP) to its authorized depths and dimensions. The proposed work consists of mechanically dredging approximately 5,500,000 cubic yards (cy) of material using closed clamshell buckets for both major sequences of work over the course of two years. The new CAD cell will be in the Edgewood Basin area located adjacent to the Providence FNP (hereafter the �Edgewood Shoals North (ESN) CAD cell�). To access the CAD cell area, an access channel will be dug between the Providence FNP and the CAD cell area. The access channel will be approximately 100 ft wide and -25 MLLW deep. The CAD cell will have surface dimensions of approximately 1000 ft. by 1000 ft. and be dug to a depth of -60 MLLW. The material excavated to build the access channel is generally a mix of sandy silt and shell fragments. Within the CAD cell area the material is generally described as soft grey to black organic silt with some layers of firm sandy silt and some shell fragments and coarse-grained material. Material excavated from the access channel and CAD cell area will be placed at four locations: Port Edgewood Basin, the Fox Point Reach CAD cells, Prudence Island Disposal Site, and the Rhode Island Sound Disposal Site. This work consists of mechanically dredging approximately 3,200,000 cy to construct thew ESN CAD cell and its access channel, which must be completed before maintenance dredging of the FNP can begin. The maintenance dredging proposed work consists of mechanically dredging the Providence River FNP to the full -40 MLLW depth plus 2-feet of allowable overdepth. 2,300,000 cy (1,200,000 cy required depth, with up to 1,100,000 cy overdepth) of shoaled material consisting generally of poorly graded medium to fine sand with silt. The dredge material from this maintenance portion of work will be placed in the ESN CAD cell. Environmental coordination and permitting is being completed by the U.S. Army of Engineers, New England District. All dredging and disposal activities for this project have prescribed work windows that incorporate environmental and recreational time of year restrictions. Refer to the Draft Specification Section provided with this announcement for specifics on the time of year work restrictions. In order to accomplish all dredging requirements within the specified dredging window it is expected that the Contractor will need to meet a production rate of 300,000 CY per 30 calendar days. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is requesting responses to the questions below from both small and large businesses[MC1] . Draft drawings showing a concept design plan and draft Specification Section of 01 11 00 SUMMARY OF WORK have been provided with this announcement to help provide more context for the contract work and responses to these questions. Considering the different disposal locations, are there suggestions on a bid structure that will provide for the most accurate costs of different disposal locations? Any draft restrictions that may impact dredging and/or disposal operations? Any concerns on the period of performance of September 2027 to September 2029 considering the environmental windows and amount of work? If so, why? Any comments about the bed leveling planned in the Fox Point Reach? Are there concerns about this part of the plan, if so, why? Interested firms should also demonstrate their project experience, by providing two (2) projects within the last ten years, which meet the following requirements: Dredging by mechanical means demonstrating a minimum production rate of 300,000 cubic yards in one consecutive 30-day period. Experience with placement of dredged material at an open water placement site in New England during the fall/winter months of October through March. Interested firms should submit a capabilities package to include the following: business classification (i.e. HUBZone, etc.), type of equipment the firm is proposing to use on the project, and two (2) example projects performed by the firm in the last ten (10) years (including Points of Contact for those projects) showing experience with the proposed equipment at the production rate listed above. Please indicate the team subcontractor(s) (if any), including their prior experience and qualifications meeting the same qualifications listed above, which will be used to support the bidder's effort. Firms may use subcontractor experience to demonstrate experience with the requirements, but the role and work performed by each team member (prime and subcontractors) on projects demonstrating that team member's experience shall be the same as the role for that team member for this project. Bid bond will need to be provided with the bid. Responses are limited to twenty pages and due by November 26 , 2026. Responses should be addressed to the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District, 696 Virginia Road, Concord, MA 01742-2751, ATTN: Kyle Hall, or electronically to Kyle.K.Hall@usace.army.mil. The Government will not pay for any material provided in response to this market survey nor return the data provided. This notice is for information purposes only and is not a request to be placed on a solicitation mailing list nor is it a Request for Proposal (RFP) or an announcement of a solicitation. The results of this survey will be considered to be in effect for a period of one year from the date of this notice. Government Agency URL: www.nae.usace.army.mil Government Agency URL Description: New England District, Corps of Engineers

title: Rakennusurakointitöiden puitehankinta vuosille 2027-2029
description: Rakennusurakointitöiden puitehankinta vuosille 2027-2029 Naantalin kaupungin yksiköt (Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia rakennusurakointitöiden toteuttamisesta sopimuskaudelle. Hankinnan kohteena olevat työt toteutetaan joko erikseen minikilpailutettavina toimeksiantoina tai suoraan hankittavina töinä sopimusehtojen mukaisesti. Rakennusurakoita kilpailutetaan lisäksi kohdekohtaisilla urakkakilpailulla. Sopimuskauden arvioitu alkamisajankohta on 1.1.2027. Lisäksi Tilaaja varaa mahdollisuuden kahteen optiovuoteen (1+1). Optiolla tarkoitetaan mahdollisuutta sopimuksen jatkamiseen alkuperäisin ehdoin. Tilaaja päättää optioiden käytöstä erikseen. Hankinta tullaan toteuttamaan puitejärjestelynä. Tilattavien töiden sisältö ja määrä eivät ole ennalta tiedossa eikä Tilaaja sitoudu mihinkään hankintamääriin sopimuskauden aikana. Pienurakat voivat sisältää rakennus-, maalaus-, matto-, tasoite-, vedeneristys- sekä laatoitus- ja teräsrakennetöitä. Urakat toteutetaan noudattaen rakennusalan yleisiä sopimusehtoja YSE 1998.,

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Planungsleistungen für ein Nahwärmenetz der Leistungsphasen 2 – 4 in den Quartieren Gildekamp und Gotthunkamp in der Stadt Röbel/Müritz.
description: Die Stadt Röbel/Müritz erwägt den Neubau eines innovativen Nahwärmenetzes in den Quartieren Gildekamp und Gotthunskamp mit Potential zur Erweiterung und damit zum Anschluss anderer Quartiere der Stadt. Das Ziel ist der Aufbau einer zukunftssicheren, CO2-mindernden und wirtschaftlichen Wärmeversorgung der Stadt Röbel/Müritz in Teilabschnitten bis 2045. Dabei sind die Anforderungen, die sich aus dem Wärmeplanungsgesetz vom 20.12.2023 § 30 Abs. 1 und § 31 Abs. 1 ergeben einzuhalten. Gegenstand der zu vergebenden Leistung ist die Erbringung der stufenweisen Planungsleistungen gemäß § 53 der Leistungsphasen 2 bis 4 HOAI (Vorplanung, Entwurfsplanung, Genehmigungsplanung) für das Nahwärmenetz Röbel, unter Beachtung der Anforderungen der BEW-Förderrichtlinie (Fassung vom 16. Dezember 2025). Die Leistungen müssen die im BAFA-Merkblatt („Bundesförderung für effiziente Wärmenetze – Merkblatt Antragstellung, technische Anforderungen und Verwendungsnachweis) definierten Mindestinhalte nach Ziffer 4.2.3 vollständig abdecken.

title: RFI Process control system plumbing and programming
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the US Army DEVCOM Soldier Center to identify potential sources to provide expert engineering support to trouble shoot process control system providing steam water and air. Must have expertise in process control plumbing and control valves for steam systems. Must have expertise in Allen Bradley PLC programming. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and Wesley.s.shaw.civ@army.mil by November 26th, 2026 by 5pm EST. Background: The Government (DEVCOM Soldier Center) is in need of expert engineering support to diagnose current PLC and piping system which support multiple hydraulic press systems. The existing system controls water, steam and air to molding tooling, and the PLC operates on custom Allen-Bradley control software. As it stands, the system is physically installed, however does not provide necessary temperature control in either manual or automatic modes. Issues may be traced to the original system design, pipe rack installation, PLC programming or some combination of the three. Description: Expert engineering services are sought to diagnose newly installed PLC control system to ensure that it can meet system design requirements, can be operated safely and reliably, and is adaptable for future operation and changing requirements. A new PLC system has been designed and installed per a list of system requirements, however is not able to control temperature per design requirements either due to control logic, poor valve selection or related piping design/installation. SC requires a 3rd party engineering service to validate as-built drawings against the installed system, verify/update PLC programming, provide necessary hardware changes to bring the system up to full operability. Specific System Specifications: Electric steam boiler provides 125psi dry steam as primary heat source for molding tooling. Standalone chiller provides chilled water at ~60 psi, and house air provides air for purge and mist functions. The Allen-Bradley PLC system controls the various media through a series of modulating valves to heat or cool the tooling. The PLC is intended to have recipe writing and management for automated control. Basic recipe for our process includes steam heat via pressure control to desired temperature setpoint, hold for ~1 hr while controlling temperature. The tooling is then cooled with chilled water at a controlled cooling rate. Our standard tooling includes an upper and lower platen, and the PLC has capability to control these independently. Additional system requirements will be included if there is a future RFP. Current known system issues: System will not maintain equivalent temperature for upper and lower platens during heat up or hold. System will not control cooling rate based on system feedback loop. System trend screen not displaying data correctly. System alarms remain untested. Mist function does not function without vibration of piping rack. Unique Vendor qualifications: Potential vendor must be US based and employ US citizens identified to work on the PLC system due to sensitivity of materials and products produced by the installation laboratory. Potential vendor must be licensed in process system design with specific expertise in steam controls. Potential vendor must be able to read modify and update Allen Bradly system code. Deliverables: Full system walkdown and comparison to As-built drawings. Analysis of system design, layout, valve selection, PLC operability as compared to provided list of system requirements. List of proposed design changes to meet system requirements and cost of implementation. Install required hardware and make required changes to system software. May subcontract for implementation of hardware changes. Provide updated As-built drawings for plumbing systems, electrical systems, PLC controls systems. System demonstration and verification to the As-built drawings provided Modified code in digital and hardcopy. Verified system manual. Full system demonstration and minimum 1 day training on system operation. Delivery Date: Government estimates work will be completed within 6 months of date of contract award. Government Furnished Property (Equipment/Materials/Information/Computer Utilization): All work to be performed on site at SC with access to existing PLC and piping rack. Interested parties are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Announcement. THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY This Sources Sought Announcement is issued solely for information and planning purposes and to identify interested sources. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION. No contract will be awarded from this announcement. This Sources Sought does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. It is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. Further, unsolicited proposals will not be accepted. Funding is not available at this time. The United States Army has not made a commitment to procure any of the items/services discussed, and release of this Sources Sought Announcement should not be construed as such a commitment or as authorization to incur cost for which reimbursement would be required or sought. Response to this Sources Sought Announcement is voluntary and no reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this and any follow-on information requests. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Not responding to this Sources Sought Announcement does not preclude participation in any future RFP if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized in the SAM.gov website. It is the responsibility of the potential responders to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this subject. RESPONSES: Interested parties may identify their interest and capability by sending responses regarding this requirement to DEVCOM Soldier Center via e-mail to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and Wesley.s.shaw@army.mil no later than November 26th, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. EST. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative cost incurred in response to this Notice. All costs associated with responding to this Notice will be solely at the expense of the interested party. Verbal questions will NOT be accepted. Questions shall NOT contain proprietary or classified information. description: Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice Page 21 of 21 Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice Combined Synopsis/Solicitation Notice Page 1 of 21 COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION Department of Veterans Affairs VA Medical Center, Manchester, NH Solicitation Number:� 36C24127Q0030 Title:� Manchester IT Service UPS Replacement and Maintenance Contract Issuing Office:� Network Contracting Office (NCO) 1 Point of Contact:� Shawn Lawrence, Contract Specialist, 914-737-4400 ext. 202121, Shawn.Lawrence@va.gov; David Valenzuela, Contracting Officer, David.Valenzuela2@va.gov DESCRIPTION This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) FAR Subpart 12.202, "Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Products and Commercial Services," as supplemented with additional information included in this notice.� This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested, and a written solicitation document will not be issued. This solicitation is issued as a� Request for Quotation (RFQ). The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular� FAC 2026-01 (March 13, 2026). Set-Aside:� This acquisition is� 100% set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB)� NAICS Code:� 811310 Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance Small Business Size Standard:� $12.5 Million Product/Service Code (PSC):� J061 REQUIREMENT SUMMARY The Manchester VA Medical Center requires replacement of an existing end-of-life uninterruptible power supply (UPS) system and ongoing preventative maintenance, inspection, standby labor, emergency repair, parts, and training for the replacement UPS over a Base Year plus four (4) Option Years. Place of Performance: VA Medical Center, Manchester 718 Smyth Road Manchester, NH 03104 Country: United States Period of Performance: Base Year: January 4, 2027 through January 3, 2028 Option Year 1 4: successive 12-month periods, if exercised This solicitation includes� FAR 52.217-9, Option to Extend the Term of the Contract. Hours of Operation:� Normal work 0700 1630, Monday Friday, unless otherwise authorized by the COR. Emergency response within 4 hours. SITE VISIT A site visit will be conducted on� Monday, November 16, 2026 at 9:00 AM EST� at the VA Medical Center, Manchester, 718 Smyth Road, Manchester, NH 03104. The purpose is to allow quoters to inspect the existing Eaton Powerware 9390 UPS, the installation location, access routes, and site conditions relevant to the UPS replacement and ongoing maintenance. Attendance is recommended but not required� to submit a quotation. Quoters who do not attend are responsible for obtaining the information necessary to prepare a quote and will not be relieved of any contract obligation on the basis of not having attended. Quoters intending to attend shall notify the Contract Specialist by email at� Shawn.Lawrence@va.gov� no later than� Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 5:00 PM EST, providing the names, company, and citizenship of each attendee for facility access. Each attendee shall bring a valid government-issued photo ID and report to Facility Service in Building 6 upon arrival. Attendees shall comply with all facility safety, PPE, and security requirements. Statements made during the site visit do not change the solicitation. Any information that affects the solicitation will be furnished to all quoters only through a written amendment. Questions raised at the site visit should be submitted in writing per the instructions in 52.212-1 to receive a binding Government response. Quotation delivery:� Submit quotations via email to� Shawn.Lawrence@va.gov� no later than� November 26, 2026 at 5:00 PM EST. Questions regarding this solicitation shall be submitted in writing by email to the Point of Contact no later than� 5:00 PM EST on November 19, 2026. Performance is at VAMC Manchester, 718 Smyth Road, Manchester, NH 03104. 2.0 BACKGROUND VA Manchester's UPS has required periodic preventative maintenance (PM). Due to the age of the current unit (Eaton Powerware 9390 System, Model 80, with forty (40) Hitachi Chemical Energy Technology 12V 540W cell batteries, model HRC12540WP), a replacement UPS is required. The replacement UPS shall be an� Eaton 93E UPS and Extended Battery Life Cabinet, or equivalent.� After replacement, a continuing UPS maintenance contract shall service the unit. title: RFI Process control system plumbing and programming
description: SYNOPSIS: This Sources Sought Announcement is to assist the US Army DEVCOM Soldier Center to identify potential sources to provide expert engineering support to trouble shoot process control system providing steam water and air. Must have expertise in process control plumbing and control valves for steam systems. Must have expertise in Allen Bradley PLC programming. The Government requests that responses be submitted electronically to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and Wesley.s.shaw.civ@army.mil by November 26th, 2026 by 5pm EST. Background: The Government (DEVCOM Soldier Center) is in need of expert engineering support to diagnose current PLC and piping system which support multiple hydraulic press systems. The existing system controls water, steam and air to molding tooling, and the PLC operates on custom Allen-Bradley control software. As it stands, the system is physically installed, however does not provide necessary temperature control in either manual or automatic modes. Issues may be traced to the original system design, pipe rack installation, PLC programming or some combination of the three. Description: Expert engineering services are sought to diagnose newly installed PLC control system to ensure that it can meet system design requirements, can be operated safely and reliably, and is adaptable for future operation and changing requirements. A new PLC system has been designed and installed per a list of system requirements, however is not able to control temperature per design requirements either due to control logic, poor valve selection or related piping design/installation. SC requires a 3rd party engineering service to validate as-built drawings against the installed system, verify/update PLC programming, provide necessary hardware changes to bring the system up to full operability. Specific System Specifications: Electric steam boiler provides 125psi dry steam as primary heat source for molding tooling. Standalone chiller provides chilled water at ~60 psi, and house air provides air for purge and mist functions. The Allen-Bradley PLC system controls the various media through a series of modulating valves to heat or cool the tooling. The PLC is intended to have recipe writing and management for automated control. Basic recipe for our process includes steam heat via pressure control to desired temperature setpoint, hold for ~1 hr while controlling temperature. The tooling is then cooled with chilled water at a controlled cooling rate. Our standard tooling includes an upper and lower platen, and the PLC has capability to control these independently. Additional system requirements will be included if there is a future RFP. Current known system issues: System will not maintain equivalent temperature for upper and lower platens during heat up or hold. System will not control cooling rate based on system feedback loop. System trend screen not displaying data correctly. System alarms remain untested. Mist function does not function without vibration of piping rack. Unique Vendor qualifications: Potential vendor must be US based and employ US citizens identified to work on the PLC system due to sensitivity of materials and products produced by the installation laboratory. Potential vendor must be licensed in process system design with specific expertise in steam controls. Potential vendor must be able to read modify and update Allen Bradly system code. Deliverables: Full system walkdown and comparison to As-built drawings. Analysis of system design, layout, valve selection, PLC operability as compared to provided list of system requirements. List of proposed design changes to meet system requirements and cost of implementation. Install required hardware and make required changes to system software. May subcontract for implementation of hardware changes. Provide updated As-built drawings for plumbing systems, electrical systems, PLC controls systems. System demonstration and verification to the As-built drawings provided Modified code in digital and hardcopy. Verified system manual. Full system demonstration and minimum 1 day training on system operation. Delivery Date: Government estimates work will be completed within 6 months of date of contract award. Government Furnished Property (Equipment/Materials/Information/Computer Utilization): All work to be performed on site at SC with access to existing PLC and piping rack. Interested parties are invited to submit a response to this Sources Sought Announcement. THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY This Sources Sought Announcement is issued solely for information and planning purposes and to identify interested sources. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION. No contract will be awarded from this announcement. This Sources Sought does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. It is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. Further, unsolicited proposals will not be accepted. Funding is not available at this time. The United States Army has not made a commitment to procure any of the items/services discussed, and release of this Sources Sought Announcement should not be construed as such a commitment or as authorization to incur cost for which reimbursement would be required or sought. Response to this Sources Sought Announcement is voluntary and no reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this and any follow-on information requests. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. Not responding to this Sources Sought Announcement does not preclude participation in any future RFP if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized in the SAM.gov website. It is the responsibility of the potential responders to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this subject. RESPONSES: Interested parties may identify their interest and capability by sending responses regarding this requirement to DEVCOM Soldier Center via e-mail to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and Wesley.s.shaw@army.mil no later than November 26th, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. EST. The U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative cost incurred in response to this Notice. All costs associated with responding to this Notice will be solely at the expense of the interested party. Please provide business size (indicate your socioeconomic status), applicable NAICS code, and CAGE code. If you hold a GSA Federal Supply Schedule contract, please identify your contract number. QUESTIONS: Any questions for clarification may be emailed to mary.k.prebensen.civ@army.mil and Wesley.s.shaw@army.mil no later than November 20th, 2026 by 5:00 p.m. EST. Verbal questions will NOT be accepted. Questions shall NOT contain proprietary or classified information. An unattributed list of questions and answers will be published at the same web location of this Sources Sought Announcement.

buyer: European Commission, DG REGIO - Regional and Urban Policy
title: Belgium – Business and management consultancy and related services – Learning through Experimentation for Adaptive Programming (LEAP) - Producing experimental designs for ERDF/CF/JTF investment in the field of access to quality public services
description: The overarching goal of this assignment is to prepare the ground for embedding experimentation in National and Regional Partnership Plans (NRPPs) from the outset of the 2028–2034 programming period. To this end, the assignment will structurally bring evaluators and programmers to work together, build capacity on both sides, and provide the EU evaluation system with practical experimentation tools that extend beyond the three participating MS. This assignment focuses on investments on access to public services and shall produce the following outputs: 1. NRPP-ready experimental designs to be implemented in the 2028–2034 programming period in three Member States; 2. a detailed toolkit to support MS in the introduction of experimental designs in 2028-2034 Plans: LEAP Kit (Learning through Experimentation for Adaptive Programming). Access to quality public services is central to the Right to Stay initiative and to the social and territorial cohesion objectives of the EU. Ensuring that services remain within reach of citizens, particularly in lagging and rural regions, is increasingly challenging as budgets tighten and demographic pressures intensify. The constraint is often not only that infrastructure is missing or outdated, but its accessibility and quality is not up to standards. The question of intervention approaches in this regard is underexplored and poorly evidenced. Experimentation through randomised controlled trials (RCTs) - and the analysis of experiment results to identify the causal effects of interventions - offers the most rigorous way to generate this evidence. Improving the capacity to design and conduct experimental designs is even more important in light of the evolving regulatory context. The Commission proposal for the 2028-2034 Multiannual Financial Framework explicitly promotes policy learning and experimentation as a function of both coordinating and managing authorities (Articles 50 and 51 of the proposed Performance Regulation). DG REGIO’s ambition is that experimental designs and adaptive learning mechanisms will be embedded in the NRPPs from the outset of the next programming period.

title: Germany – Architectural and related services – Neubau Verwaltungsgebäude der Verbandsgemeindewerke in Bernkastel-Kues / Andel: Los 1 - Leistungen der Objektplanung Gebäude und Freianlagen
description: Gegenstand der Planungsaufgabe ist der Neubau eines Verwaltungsgebäudes der Verbandsgemeindewerke in Bernkastel-Kues im Stadtteil Andel einschließlich der zugehörigen Freianlagen und der Einbindung in den bestehenden Betriebsstandort auf dem Grundstück "Moselbahnstraße 14 in 54470 Bernkastel-Kues / Andel". Für das Vorhaben liegt bereits ein erster Konzeptentwurf vor, der als Grundlage für die weitere Planung dient. Der derzeitige Planungsstand sieht ein zweigeschossiges Verwaltungsgebäude mit einem Brutto-Rauminhalt (BRI) von ca. 3.061 m³, einer Brutto-Grundfläche (BGF) von ca. 840 m², einer Netto-Raumfläche (NRF) von ca. 604 m² sowie einer Nutzfläche (NUF) von ca. 410 m² vor. Das Raumprogramm umfasst im wesentlichen Büroarbeitsplätze für technische und kaufmännische Bereiche sowie Besprechungs-, Kommunikations-, Sozial-, Technik- und entsprechende Sanitär- und Nebenräume. Der vorliegende Konzeptentwurf sieht eine flexible und langfristig anpassbare Gebäudestruktur in einem klaren Baukörper vor, in einer zeitgemäßen und energieeffizienten Bauweise. Ein zentraler, über die beiden Geschosse offener Lichthof innerhalb der Erschließungszone bildet den räumlichen Mittelpunkt des Gebäudes und dient der Belichtung, Kommunikation und natürlichen Belüftung der angrenzenden Bereiche. Die einzelnen Funktionsbereiche im Gebäude "Büros/Besprechung", "Erschließung" und "Nebenräume" sind klar gegliedert, gleichzeitig entsteht über die Mitte des Gebäudes und den Lichthof eine offene Kommunikationszone mit Aufenthaltsqualität. Wesentliche Entwurfsziele sind eine hohe Nutzungsflexibilität und langfristige Anpassungsfähigkeit der Grundrissstruktur sowie kurze, funktionale Wege innerhalb des Gebäudes und eine gute Anbindung und Sichtbeziehung an das bestehende Betriebsgebäude auf dem Grundstück. Der beauftragte Objektplaner hat die bisherige Konzeption und das zugrunde liegende Raum- und Funktionsprogramm gemeinsam mit dem Auftraggeber zu überprüfen, gegeben falls weiterzuentwickeln und mit den beteiligten Fachplanern abzustimmen. Dabei sind insbesondere Funktionalität, Wirtschaftlichkeit, Nachhaltigkeit, Energieeffizienz und die langfristige Nutzungsflexibilität, aber auch eine differenzierte Fassadengestaltung zu berücksichtigen. Mit Wirkung zum 01.01.2027 werden die Verbandsgemeindewerke Bernkastel-Kues in die Verbandsgemeindewerke AöR umgewandelt. Die AöR übernimmt alle Rechte und Pflichten der Verbandsgemeindewerke Bernkastel-Kues. Hinsichtlich der Einzelheiten wird Bezug genommen auf die beigefügte Leistungsbeschreibung Bezug genommen, welche Bestandteil der Vergabeunterlagen/Vertragsunterlagen ist.

title: Sweden – Acoustic devices – Nytt PA-system Väven
description: Umeå kommun avser att upphandla ett nytt PA-system till Kulturhuset Väven. Vävenscenen är en multiscen som nyttjas för en rad av olika arrangemang t.ex. teater, föreläsningar, seminarier, musikuppträdande, konserter samt dansföreställningar. ​Befintligt ljudsystem är inte ändamålsenligt med Vävenscenens föreställningar. Systemet är underdimensionerat, framför allt vid konserter med stående publik. ​Efter utredning är slutsatsen att ett L-Acoustics L2D är mest lämpat för Vävenscenen. Valet av ett PA av denna typ har flera anledningar: * möjligheten att i mjukvara förändra ljudtäckning utefter PA:ts placering i rummet på enklaste och snabbaste sätt. * den fysiska storleken och utformningen gör det effektivare att flytta och använda då korta tidsintervaller för omställning ofta förekommer. * systemets kardioidlösning bidrar till minskad rundgångskänslighet. * systemet är kompatibelt med redan befintligt PA-system på Kajscenen ​* L-Acoustics används av flera ljudfirmor i Umeå så god kännedom om PA:t finns i närheten och möjligheten för kompletteringar blir desto enklare. ​Likvärdiga PA-system är dock självklart godkända. ​Utöver ovanstående finns övriga krav, leverans, montering samt tekniska specifikationer uppsatta enligt bilaga. ​Upphandlingen genomförs i enlighet med bestämmelserna i lagen (2016:1145) om offentlig upphandling (LOU) med de lagändringar som trädde i kraft 2022-02-01. Upphandlingsformen är öppet förfarande.

title: Sweden – Vending machines – Upphandling av hyra av varuautomater för nikotin- och tobak till Statens institutionsstyrelse
description: SiS inbjuder till anbudsgivning gällande Upphandling av hyra av varuautomater för nikotin- och tobaksprodukter för SiS LVM-hem enligt nedanstående instruktioner och bifogade handlingar med diarienummer 2.2-9233-2026. Avrop kommer att genomföras i enlighet med upphandlingsdokumenten. Bakgrund Många klienter som får vård- och behandling på SiS LVM-hem har behov av att genomföra inköp av nikotin- och tobaksprodukter under sin tid på hemmen. Eftersom klienterna ofta har begränsade möjligheter att lämna institutionsområdet så avser SiS nu att upphandla ramavtal för hyra av varuautomater. Syftet med upphandlingen är att underlätta införskaffandet av och bidra till att effektivisera och förenkla inköp av nikotin- och tobaksprodukter för klienter som själva genomför köpen inom institutionsområdet. Uppdragsbeskrivning Upphandlingen avser hyra av varuautomater för nikotin- och tobaksprodukter inklusive teknisk service och påfyllnad av produkter. Med teknisk service avses att anbudsgivaren ansvarar för alla tillstånd för att sälja nikotin- och tobaksprodukter, att alla lagkrav på både försäljning och automater efterlevs samt för service, reparationer, rengöring, hantering av reklamationer, svinn och annat som krävs för att säkerställa en god driftsäkerhet och funktion. Avropsberättigande enheter är SiS samtliga LVM-hem. Avrop genomförs vid behov av respektive LVM-hem. Behov av sortiment i varuautomaterna kan komma att skilja mellan olika LVM-hem, till exempel olika utbud av nikotin- och tobaksprodukter såsom cigaretter och snus. Avtalsvärdet för denna upphandling är satt till 9 000 000 SEK och takvolymen är begränsad till 11 000 000 SEK. SiS garanterar inga volymer, anbudsgivare åtar sig att leverera mot det faktiska behov som uppstår. Ovanstående angivna värden utgör endast en vägledning. Det framtida behovet kan komma att understiga ovan angivna takvolymer. Preliminär avtalsperiod är från och med 2026-12-16 till och med 2028-12-15. Beställaren har därefter rätt, men ej skyldighet, att förlänga Avtalet med ett (1) år i taget i totalt två (2) år. Avtalsperioden kan därmed löpa som längst till och med 2030-12-15. Avtalet förlängs per automatik med ett (1) år i taget om inte Beställaren meddelar annat senast tre (3) månader innan Avtalet löper ut.

description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.02.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.01.2027. Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

title: USCG Station at Cape Disappointment
description: General. This is a SOURCES SOUGHT and is for informational/market research purposes only. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, QUOTATION OR BID, NOR A SYNOPSIS OF A PROPOSED CONTRACT ACTION UNDER RFO FAR SUBPART 5.1, PRESOLICITATION. This Sources Sought is to gain knowledge of the interest, capabilities, and qualifications of industry so the government can make informed business decisions. We are seeking responses from both large and small business members of industry to include: Small Business, Small Disadvantaged Businesses to include 8(a) firms, Historically Underutilized Business Zones (HUBZone), Woman Owned Small Business (WOSB) to include Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small business (SDVOSB) and Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB). All interested parties are highly encouraged to respond. The North American Industrial Classification Code (NAICS) for this requirement is: TBD - The approximate value of Project will be $50M to $100M. Formal Sources Sought Response Due � before 3:00 pm PDT on 26 November 2026 2. Project Details and Background. The USCG Station at Cape Disappointment requires repairs, upgrades, and improvements to existing infrastructure and nearby areas to restore and retain full mission readiness. The Station is on an unstable sandbar which has experienced sediment migration into dock and adjacent waterway areas. Dock structures are failing and require repair/replacement. The vessel haul-out facility is currently inoperable due to sedimentation and requires the USCG to conduct frequent maintenance dredging. Haul-out structure is failing and requires replacement. Adjacent landscape features pose rockfall dangers above the engineering and maintenance buildings to people and property 3. Project Scope. Rockfall slope instability corrective measures: Anticipated rockfall mitigation will require corrective measures including but not limited to tree removal, rock scaling, rock dowel installation, draped mesh removal and replacement, removal and/or repair of an existing damaged ringnet fence, and installation of a midslope attenuator system. Rockfall mitigation will require difficult access techniques to reach the full height of the hazardous slope. Temporary protection of the facility and workers will be required. Repairs to damaged roadways, utilities or access pathways may be required. Repair of an existing small landslide slump along the access road is required. Final mitigation work will reduce rockfall risk to USCG personnel and facility. Waterfront structures and vessel haul-out: The waterfront structures require repairs and upgrades. Replacement of the existing floating docks is required; they will retain their current configuration (footprint) but utilize updated material specifications. Existing timber and steel piles will be either replaced, or reused with new floats, as part of this contract, depending on current condition. Geotechnical, civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical scope is included. Constraints include: Float A to be retained; guide piles at floating docks #2 and #4 to be replaced; wave screens to be replaced; electrical equipment to be upgraded; existing vessel haul-out facility to be replaced. Eel grass and SAV surveys are required to inform design. Dock operations are to be maintained during construction, per phasing to be outlined by the government. Coastal Resilience and Sedimentation Remediation: Due to the catastrophic loss of the protective coastal dune, the facility requires a comprehensive permanent solution to control massive sediment migration. Bathymetric surveys, geotechnical testing, and coastal modeling are required to inform viable design and permit alternatives. The design will utilize modern, resilient coastal engineering practices including Nature-Based Solutions (NBS), dynamic revetments, segmented offshore breakwaters/sills, and the beneficial reuse of dredged sediment wherever practicable. Construction may be implemented in functional phases to optimize funding and operational readiness. Shoreline protection repairs and upgrades are considered part of this category along with the Haul Out structure. Interim repair work: Interim repair work may be required on existing structures before new design and construction activity can be completed. If the need arises, USACE will provide USCG a description of the recommended repairs and a cost estimate. If USCG would like USACE to institute repairs, an updated agreement to define the scope will be established. 4. Submission Instructions. Formal responses to this Sources Sought notice must be submitted electronically via MSForms (link is here https://forms.osi.apps.mil/r/Aivta2iThu) for answers to Section 3 Questions above and via email with supporting documentation requested here in Section 4 Submission Instructions. Submit your email with SUBJECT: "Response to questions on Cape Disappointment". Please email to Brandon Lasich Brandon.M.Lasich@usace.army.mil and Jaren Bowman, at jaren.l.bowman@usace.army.mil Interested parties� responses to this Sources Sought shall be limited to six (6) pages and shall include the following information: What is the interest in submitting a proposal for a Design Build solicitation for the dock work What would be the interest in submitting a bid for a Design Build solicitation for the Sedimentation mitigation work. What is the interest in submitting a proposal for a Progressive Design Build contract. Provide benefits and risks for Progressive Design Build for any of the scope items presented. What issues do you see with soliciting for construction contracts work as described in section 3. List the capabilities of your firm to do the design and construction of new segmented breakwater and haul structure working close to a Federal Channel, complex tidal currents and wave loading, complex movement of sand, and subject to large storm event What are the capabilities to design and construction for the renovation of new dock work. Do you have experience designing to USACE and/or USCG waterfront design criteria: USCG Configuration Standard Technical Orders relevant to this project scope UFC/USACE requirements relevant to this project scope Design for complex hydro loading conditions in shallow bays to USACE/UFC criteria. List previous design build work for doing work in complex environment where one had to consider the working close to a Federal Channel, complex tidal currents, complex movement of sand, subject to large storm events and is highly dynamic. List previous design build work for dock work. What issues do you see with the work. What issue do you see with design bid build. Provide input for benefits and negatives to separate construction contracts (for each scope item in Section 3), or a combination of scope items into 1 or 2 contracts. Rockfall Mitigation Specific Questions What construction methods are anticipated for the rock scaling, for rock dowels, mesh and attenuator installation? What is the general anticipated construction sequence to remove trees, scale rock and debris, install mitigation and make repairs to existing rockfall systems (to remain)? How will rock scaling be performed? What method(s) will prevent scaled rock and cut trees from damaging building, buried utilities? What are the anticipated types and size of equipment required to construct the rockfall systems - e.g. crane or helicopter size; wagon drill, crane mounted drill, or hand plugger; scale bar, air bag, or mechanical scaling, etc? List any constructability issues or concerns; e.g. accessibility, equipment footprints, scaling etc. What is the contractor�s experience with similar types of flexible midslope attenuator/geohazard mitigation on transportation, dam infrastructure or similar projects? During rockfall mitigation work, how fast can work stop, safely hold and clear road debris to allow USCG emergency responders full, safe access to execute rescue operations? Dock R
